prompt: Our CRM team has a batch greeting card job file at `campaign/requests/batch_q1_2025.json`. It contains 5 requests for different holidays and recipients. Your job is to process every request through the blessing generator tool available in this workspace, then collect all outputs into a single file called `blessings_report.json`. Each entry in the report must be keyed by the request ID and must include all three generated message variants produced by the tool. The tool lives somewhere under `SKILL_DIR/`. Make sure you consult its documentation before running it — the parameter names and allowed values are non-obvious and using wrong values will cause the tool to abort with an error.
